title: Orbit and Horizon Anew
author: Ada Oyelaran
blurb: Beatrix Ravensworth, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
